result.instructions: Tools for SlickText, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SlickText data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run slicktext_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run slicktext_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run slicktext_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. slicktext_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: slicktext_get_brand
tools.title: Get the brand
tools.description: Get the SlickText brand this API key belongs to: brand_id, name, website, sending-number registration details, opt-in / double-opt-in messages, inbox settings and the message credit limit. Every other tool works within this brand. GET /brands.

tools.name: slicktext_get_credit_usage
tools.title: Get message credit usage
tools.description: Message credits for the current billing period: total_credits (subscription + rollover + purchased), credits_used, credits_available and the credit limit. GET /brands/{brand_id}/usage.

tools.name: slicktext_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the brand's contacts (subscribers) with name, mobile_number, email, opt_in_status, source, custom_fields and dates. Filters are exact, case-sensitive matches (SlickText has no partial search). Paged: returns count, has_more and next_offset. GET /brands/{brand_id}/contacts.

opt_in_status.description: Only contacts with this opt-in status.

custom_fields.description: Exact-match filters on custom fields, keyed by internal_name (see slicktext_list_custom_fields), e.g. {"favorite_color": "blue"}.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: slicktext_find_contact
tools.title: Find a contact by phone or email
tools.description: Find contacts by mobile number or email address (exact match). A 10-digit US number is matched as +1XXXXXXXXXX, the way SlickText stores numbers. Use it before creating a contact to avoid duplicates. GET /brands/{brand_id}/contacts?mobile_number=… or ?email=….

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

annotations.title: Find a contact by phone or email

tools.name: slicktext_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id: name, mobile_number, email, birthdate, address, opt_in_status, source, custom_fields, time zone and dates. GET /brands/{brand_id}/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: slicktext_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the brand's contact custom fields: name, internal_name (the key used in contact filters and writes), data_type and description. GET /brands/{brand_id}/custom-fields.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: slicktext_list_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: List the brand's contact lists (contact_list_id, name, description, created). Optional exact name filter. GET /brands/{brand_id}/lists.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: slicktext_get_list
tools.title: Get a contact list
tools.description: Get one contact list by id plus its contact count (all statuses: subscribed, not subscribed, unsubscribed, blocked). GET /brands/{brand_id}/lists/{id} and /lists/{id}/contacts/count.

list_id.description: The contact list id (a positive integer).

tools.name: slicktext_list_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts in a list
tools.description: List the contacts in one contact list (paged). GET /brands/{brand_id}/lists/{id}/contacts.

list_id.description: The contact list id (a positive integer).

opt_in_status.description: Only contacts with this opt-in status.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: slicktext_list_segments
tools.title: List segments
tools.description: List the brand's segments (rule-based contact groups: segment_id, name, description). GET /brands/{brand_id}/segments.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: slicktext_list_segment_contacts
tools.title: List contacts in a segment
tools.description: List the contacts that currently match one segment (paged). GET /brands/{brand_id}/segments/{id}/contacts.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: slicktext_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List the brand's SMS/MMS campaigns: name, body, status (e.g. draft, scheduled, queued, sent), scheduled/started/finished times, completion_percentage and audience (lists/segments and size). GET /brands/{brand_id}/campaigns.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: slicktext_get_campaign
tools.title: Get a campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign by id: body, media_url, status, audience_size, schedule and completion. GET /brands/{brand_id}/campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: slicktext_get_campaign_stats
tools.title: Get campaign performance
tools.description: Performance of one campaign: contacts reached, clicks, click_rate, unique clicks, unsubscribes, unsubscribe_rate, orders, revenue, average order value, revenue per message, plus the campaign, its audiences and links. GET /brands/{brand_id}/analytics/campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: slicktext_get_analytics
tools.title: Get brand analytics
tools.description: Brand-level analytics. metric: contacts (current totals), contact_growth, contact_add_delete_events, opt_in_status_events, campaigns, messages (messages sent), message_credits, inbox_users (assignments, closures, response times per user), inbox_tags. Optional group (allowed per metric — contacts: source|opt_in_status; contact_growth/campaigns: contact_source; contact_add_delete_events: contact_source|type; opt_in_status_events: contact_source|contact_unsubscribe_source|opt_in_status; messages: source|status|direction|weekday; message_credits: source|status), a start/end range, frequency (hour/day/month/year) and compare (YoY, QoQ, MoM, WoW, DoD, PoP). GET /brands/{brand_id}/analytics/….

group.description: Group results by this field (allowed values depend on metric; see description).

start.description: Range start, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM[:SS] (SlickText's format, no time zone (passed through as is)).

end.description: Range end, YYYY-MM-DD (= end of that day) or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM[:SS] (SlickText's format, no time zone (passed through as is)).

frequency.description: Bucket size of the time series.

tools.name: slicktext_list_keywords
tools.title: List keywords
tools.description: List the brand's text-to-join keywords (word, description, active, auto-response and opt-in messages, double opt-in). GET /brands/{brand_id}/keywords.

active.description: true = only active keywords, false = only inactive.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: slicktext_get_keyword
tools.title: Get a keyword
tools.description: Get one keyword by id, including the contact_list_ids that people who text it are added to. GET /brands/{brand_id}/keywords/{id}.

tools.name: slicktext_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List individual SMS/MMS messages sent and received by the brand: to, from, body, direction, source (Campaign, Keyword, InboxThread, API …), status (delivered, undelivered …), credits and the contact. Filters are exact matches; use to/from with a phone number to read one contact's history, or source=InboxThread with source_id = a conversation id. GET /brands/{brand_id}/messages.

source_id.description: Id of the source (a campaign id, a conversation id …).

to.description: Recipient number (outgoing messages: the contact; incoming: your number).

from.description: Sender number (incoming messages: the contact; outgoing: your number).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: slicktext_list_conversations
tools.title: List inbox conversations
tools.description: List two-way inbox conversations: status (open, pending, closed), the contact, the last message and its direction/time, assigned user, tags and unread state. GET /brands/{brand_id}/inbox-threads.

assigned_to_user_id.description: Only conversations assigned to this user id.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: slicktext_get_conversation
tools.title: Get an inbox conversation
tools.description: Get the content of one inbox conversation by its id (the _id from slicktext_list_conversations). For the message-by-message history also call slicktext_list_messages with source=InboxThread and source_id=<conversation id>. GET /brands/{brand_id}/inbox-threads/{id}/content.

tools.name: slicktext_list_inbox_tags
tools.title: List inbox tags
tools.description: List the inbox tags used to label conversations (inbox_tag_id, name, color, description). GET /brands/{brand_id}/inbox-tags.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: slicktext_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact to the brand. By default the contact is created as 'not subscribed' and gets no text. Set opt_in_status='subscribed' ONLY for people who gave explicit permission to receive texts (SlickText has a zero-tolerance policy for unsolicited texts). force_double_opt_in=true makes SlickText SEND A REAL SMS to the number asking the person to confirm. Check slicktext_find_contact first to avoid duplicates. WARNING: SlickText workflows can trigger on this event (Contact Created / Contact Field Changed / Contact Added to List) and may immediately SEND REAL TEXTS or take other actions configured in the brand's workflows. POST /brands/{brand_id}/contacts.

timezone.description: Contact time zone (SlickText accepts these four).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the field's internal_name (see slicktext_list_custom_fields), e.g. {"favorite_color": "blue"}.

opt_in_status.description: Default 'not subscribed'. 'subscribed' only with the person's explicit consent.

force_double_opt_in.description: true = SlickText texts the number a double opt-in confirmation (a real SMS).

tools.name: slicktext_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing contact (only the fields you pass are sent). opt_in_status can mark a contact unsubscribed or blocked; set it to 'subscribed' ONLY when the person explicitly agreed to receive texts. WARNING: SlickText workflows can trigger on this event (Contact Created / Contact Field Changed / Contact Added to List) and may immediately SEND REAL TEXTS or take other actions configured in the brand's workflows. PUT /brands/{brand_id}/contacts/{id}.

timezone.description: Contact time zone (SlickText accepts these four).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the field's internal_name (see slicktext_list_custom_fields), e.g. {"favorite_color": "blue"}.

opt_in_status.description: New opt-in status. 'subscribed' only with the person's explicit consent.

tools.name: slicktext_add_contact_to_lists
tools.title: Add a contact to lists
tools.description: WRITE: add one contact to one or more contact lists (it does not change the contact's opt-in status; lists are also campaign audiences). Returns SlickText's count of memberships added. WARNING: SlickText workflows can trigger on this event (Contact Created / Contact Field Changed / Contact Added to List) and may immediately SEND REAL TEXTS or take other actions configured in the brand's workflows. POST /brands/{brand_id}/lists/contacts.
